scope: json_repair release-candidate measurements: pristine json_repair 0.64.1 on CPython, the adapted port on CPython, and the port under Pystachy AOT/JIT. Synthetic checked workloads; not production traces or a general engine ranking.

source_revisions.measured_checkout: aed767171e2798403f796071e46b7ddb04da3ab8 (main plus a README.md-only change; compiler, runtime, lib, ports and bench bytes are main's)

toolchain.cpython: 3.13.18 (the pinned 3.13.16 was not installed on this host)

retention_notes: Every process is retained with its warmup and measured batches; no outlier was removed.
Source manifests are deduplicated by content; the checkout path is omitted.
Witnesses are stored once per case: the runner fails on any cross-variant mismatch.
Whole-process RSS includes the runner's pre-exec launch floor (about 47 MiB here); it resolves no CPython/AOT memory difference.

Paths are normalized: $CHECKOUT is the measured checkout, $SCRATCH a private scratch directory holding the AOT executables (bench/), a clean worktree of the same commit used by the size sweep (benchtree/) and the pristine upstream checkout (upstream/json_repair/).
